items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: there was a man, and his name was Lawrence, Lawrence Toka, not Lawrence Toka, Merkendale. Lawrence Merkendale was one of the first float builders of this city... after school, us kids would help him to paint these floats.

ctx.x: You ought to know if your parents were part of like an organization that dressed up on carnival.

My parents had a friend because in 1940, oh, I'll tell you what, I was a page on a float in 1940 with King Zulu. His name was Manuel Bernard. And he was my daddy's best friend. And I was a page. And you know, another thing is, when I went to school at Copa's Christie, there was always, we didn't worry so much about Mardi Gras, but there was the Kitty's Day Parade. And there was a man, and his name was Lawrence, Lawrence Toka, not Lawrence Toka, Merkendale. Lawrence Merkendale was one of the first float builders…
Did you run for public office? Or something?
